title: mtf.native spec
description: What an mtf.native request asks for: the engine's own MTF of the case, by the engine's own method and sampling, at the given image-space frequencies and fields. Code checks that the frequencies ascend.

frequenciesPerMm.description: Spatial frequencies in image space, cycles/mm, ascending.

oneOf.description: Fractions of the full image height, as the engine itself resolves them to field angles.
Field angles in degrees. A positive angle is an object toward +y.

method.description: geometric: from where rays land, without diffraction. diffraction: with the diffraction of the aperture.

focus.description: design: on the image plane of the case. engine-best: on the plane the engine's own focus criterion moves it to; the answer says what was applied.

profile.description: A named, documented bundle of settings of one engine, for what this spec does not state.
